text: Canvas litter: found a second, sharper bug. 4 concurrent creates all got the SAME file - the ?filename= uniquifier does existsSync-then-write with two awaits in between, so 4 nodes pointed at 1 file and 3 canvasIds were lost. Measured 8 concurrent: 1 file before, 8 after claiming the name with open(wx). Also added POST /api/delete-canvas, which refuses anything outside the board dir and anything that is not an empty canvas.

Canvas litter done. tests/board/canvas-file-lifecycle.test.mjs (port 4399, own throwaway board, 10 case groups, every assertion is a file on disk). Server half applied: POST /api/delete-canvas + atomic name claim. Client half is 3 hunks in .tmp/scratch/opus5-37/patch.json - braindump.js NOT edited, anchors re-verified unique. Five separate breaks each shown going red, incl. B: undo must take the file it created with it, 3 !== 2. Markdown notes have the identical hole and are NOT fixed; argued in notes.md.
